text.value: Continue Milestone 3 from the current repository state.Milestones 1 and 2 are already completed and committed. Do not redo or modify them.Milestone 3 was interrupted during implementation. There are existing uncommitted changes in the working tree. Treat them as work in progress: inspect and understand them first, preserve correct existing work, then continue from where the implementation stopped.Complete Milestone 3:- Extend IPC transport + TypeScript types.- Persist progress narration in the session store.- Implement the UI with collapsible Thought display while preserving chronological stream order.- Keep tool actions inline in chronological order.- Auto-scroll should follow the newest live event only when the user is already at the bottom; do not pull the user back down after they intentionally scroll upward.- Update the agent/runtime instructions so the model emits useful concise progress narration naturally during long agent work instead of exposing all internal reasoning as the primary progress UI.- Preserve behavior outside this feature.- Add/update regression tests for event ordering, transport/persistence, and relevant runtime behavior.- Run the appropriate Rust and application tests.- Review the final diff for accidental changes.Do not discard or revert the existing Milestone 3 working-tree changes unless you determine a specific change is incorrect.When Milestone 3 is genuinely complete and tests pass, create ONE commit for Milestone 3 only.Then give me a final report containing:- what you recovered from the interrupted implementation,- what you changed,- important design decisions,- tests run and results,- commit hash,- remaining manual UI checks.Work autonomously. Keep your Todo accurate as you progress.
